# Prompt for Coding AI: Build a Complete Landing Page — "Bécane" Theme

You are a senior frontend engineer. Build a complete, production-ready landing page as three separate files: `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference. All styling must live strictly in `style.css` — zero inline `style="..."` attributes. Use class/ID selectors only. Keep HTML clean, semantic, and visual-style-agnostic so the entire look can change by editing CSS alone.

## 1. Design Tokens & Theme

Define all visual tokens as CSS variables inside `:root` (light mode) and under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` plus a `.dark` class selector (mandatory dark mode). Required color tokens: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`. Required shape/spacing tokens: `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`, `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`, `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`. Enforce contrast pairing: light backgrounds pair with dark text, dark backgrounds pair with light text, in every theme.

Light-mode palette (Bécane-inspired): page canvas `#f6f6f6` (not pure white; use `#fefefe` only where a near-white is needed), divider `#e6e6e6`, text `#0a0a0a`, elevated surface `#ffffff`, muted text `#b2b2b2`, accent surface `#ff0000`. Dark mode must define equivalent tokens with proper contrast inversion. Persist user theme choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit, with a visible toggle control carrying correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label`.

Typography: load Google Fonts via `<link>`/`@import`, bind to `--font-base`. Use a geometric sans-serif stack (Eurostile → Helvetica Neue → Arial fallback) for the base; use Google Material Symbols/Icons for all icons — no raw inline SVGs or local icon files. Base label size 8px uppercase with 0.04em tracking; display wordmark 30px bold uppercase, line-height 1.0, tracking 0.04em; body copy between 12px and 30px only. Line heights: 1.0 for 30px wordmark, 1.1–1.2 for 8px labels.

Spacing scale: 7, 8, 9, 10, 20, 100px tokens. Border radius 0px on every interactive element, card, image, and button. No box-shadows anywhere — flat system relying on 0.5px hairline borders (`#e6e6e6`) and negative space. Page max-width none (full-bleed); section gap 100px; card padding 10px; element gap 8–10px.

## 2. Layout & Framework

Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind `@layer`/`@apply`) unless another framework is requested. All utility classes must map back to CSS variables or generic reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`). Build layouts with Flexbox (`display: flex`); every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless explicitly justified. Mobile-first, responsive, no horizontal scrolling, fluid sizing. Enforce one consistent class-naming convention (BEM or fixed utility set) across the whole deliverable — never mix conventions.

## 3. Component State Requirements

**Buttons:** default flex layout (`align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem`), min touch target 44x44px; hover brightness/shadow with `cursor: pointer`; distinct focus ring via CSS variables; active `transform: scale(0.97)`; loading state disables interactions and renders CSS spinner or animated Google Icon without distorting dimensions; disabled `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`; success/error temporary states via `--text-success`/`--text-error`. Ghost buttons only — transparent fill, 0px radius, no hover background change, no chromatic CTA. Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

**Cards (feature cards):** flex layout, subtle borders and elevation via `--bg-secondary` and CSS variables; hover elevation/`translateY(-2px)`; focus-within border highlight; loading skeleton shimmer in CSS; empty state with Google Icon and guidance text.

**Forms/Inputs (pricing FAQ contact, newsletter):** states empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (success border/icon), invalid (error border, red text, error icon), disabled, read-only; flex container wrapping label, input, and dedicated error feedback container.

**Modal/Popup:** states opening, open, loading, success/error, closing (CSS transitions); centered flex container, backdrop overlay, Google Icon close button, keyboard focus trapping, close via Esc or overlay click.

## 4. UX & Micro-Interactions

Responsive by default. Smooth CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`. Accessibility: sufficient contrast both themes; never rely solely on color for state; semantic HTML5; correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback. Mandatory visual feedback on every click/hover/submission. Destructive actions visually distinct.

## 5. Page Sections to Build

Landing page for a fictional brand (invent a fictional brand name, product, and copy — never use the real "Bécane" name, logo, trademarks, or product names). Sections: Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links.

Hero: left-aligned on canvas; small uppercase meta line above oversized 30px wordmark; no underlines/accent bars. Features: 3 cards with 0px radius, hairline borders, no shadows. How It Works: 3 steps. Testimonials: quotes with attribution. Pricing: 3 tiers with feature lists. FAQ: accordion. Final CTA: single strong call. Footer: stacked 8px uppercase labels, email link same treatment as policy links, no hierarchy.

Red accent (`#ff0000`) reserved for a single accent surface per viewport — not a button/CTA. Product/feature imagery: 0px radius, no clip-path, no card chrome, edge-to-edge where applicable. No lorem-ipsum-only submissions where real copy is supplied; placeholders only where content genuinely unspecified.

## 6. Deliverables

Separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline script beyond deferred entry point. Consistent naming convention. Dark mode mandatory with toggle + persistence. Output only the finished prompt — no preamble, no closing commentary. Mirror numbered headers and bolded sub-rules. If any request conflicts with a mandatory rule, keep the rule and add a one-line explicit exception clause. All copy in English. All CSS variable names, class names, file names in English/ASCII.
